No m"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"iddleman, no extra inference cost."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Pattern | LLM Role | Representative |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **LLM-Embedded** | Executor inside the pipeline | Mem0, Letta |

Mnemon's three primitives — `remember`, `link`, "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"`recall` — form an intent-native protocol: command names map to the LLM's cognitive vocabulary (`rem"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ember` not INSERT, `recall` not SELECT), and output is structured JSON with signal transparency rath"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"er than raw database rows."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The LLM-Supervised pattern: hooks drive the lifecycle, the host LLM makes judgment calls, the binary"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" handles deterministic computation."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Memory has a **compound interest effect** — the longer it accumulates, the greater its value. the closest native"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" mapping for each supported runtime."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The four hook phases are reminders, not a hard workflow. **Prime** makes the

memory is useful."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Zero user-side operation** — install once; supported runtimes can use hooks, minimal runtimes ca"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"n use persistent rules

- **Multi-framework support** — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ZCode,"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" TRAE/TRAE Work, Qoder/QoderWork, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Kimi Code, OpenCode, and Hermes Agent (hooks"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"/plugins), OpenClaw (plugins), Pi (extensions), Alma (skill + `app.ready` hook), MiniMax Code and Na"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"nobot (skills), DeepSeek Harness (via the dsh-mnemon plugin), and more

- **Intent-aware rec"},{"id":"p30s11","text":"all** — graph traversal + optional vector search (RRF fusion), enabled by default for all queries
